messages:
maria: Heads-up: launching a short experiment today — pricing microcalculator + CTA routing. Updated FAQ line in the draft doc: https://docs.redwood.com/sheets/pricing-mini-calc

devon: Nice. Routing split? webinar vs demo?

maria: Yes. Variant W -> webinar sign-up (low friction). Variant D -> demo request (sales handoff).

ashley: Put a tiny tokens/month slider inline. Quick numbers reduce drop-off. :bar_chart:

kevin: Keep estimator client-side. Pseudocode: ```js
const labels=["Free","Starter","Performance","Enterprise"];
function labelFor(tokens){return labels[Math.min(Math.floor(tokens/50000),3)];}
```

samir: I recommended swapping "Scale" for "Performance" to signal latency/throughput. Might only show that label in the calculator for the A variant.

maria: Ops wants minimal churn. We'll A/B label only in UI with a feature flag.

devon: I'll add flag X_EXP_CALC_TIER_LABEL=perf_ui_test and ensure analytics tags carry `tier_label`.

ashley: Events: `pricing_calc_open`, `estimator_change`, `cta_click`. Include props: `variant`, `tier_label`, `route` (webinar|demo).

kevin: Add a micro-benchmark under Performance: "~20-40ms median token latency on p4-class infra" — approximate. Samir, can infra sign off?

samir: I'll confirm numbers. If needed we'll soften to "typical median token latency in low tens of ms".

maria: Plan: roll out 20% in AU region at 14:00 UTC, monitor engagement for 90 minutes, then widen. I'll draft the launch note and webhook for the webinar reg UTMs. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
